entries.reason: Duties preserves forall applicable aspects of the same claim/grounds pair, and empirical-only records fail for the concrete empirical/value fixture. Aspect has three constructors; it is a stipulated application ontology, not a derived exhaustive classification. mixed_projection projects an assumed duty and bothExamined stipulates records. None models the substantive empirical/inferential/value assessment responsibilities or validates the examined relation.
entries.reason_zh: Duties保留同一主张/根据对上每个适用面的全称责任，经验/价值混合实例确实拒绝仅有经验记录。Aspect的三个构造子是预设应用分类，不是推导出的穷尽分类；mixed_projection展开既有责任假设，bothExamined预设记录。均未建模经验、推论、价值考察的实质责任，也未验证examined关系。

entries.reason: Assessed deliberately ignores labels while using actual applicability, so any two label lists are definitionally equivalent and an empty list cannot hide a missing applicable value record. This is a conditional interface design and concrete omission probe, not an independent proof that a real classifier found every applicable responsibility.
entries.reason_zh: Assessed刻意忽略labels并依据实际适用性，因此任意标签列表在定义上等价，空列表也不能掩盖适用价值记录的缺失。这是条件化接口设计及具体遗漏探针，并非实际分类器发现全部适用责任的独立证明。
